backup.production_rule: Guest ID photo rotation: new nullable column guest_companions.id_photo_rotation smallint (0, 90, 180, 270), reset to null by a BEFORE UPDATE OF id_photo_path trigger when the photo is replaced; read through staff_photo_rotation_v1 (only paths the caller may view, at most 50) and written through set_guest_photo_rotation_v1 (owner/admin; 22023 rotation_invalid, {ok:false,error:not_found}). Notice close: ops_notice_close_v1 (owner/admin) sets ops_notices.is_active = false for any source on the caller's property, audited by the existing admin_audit_row trigger. notices_v1 lists open verifier findings only (an acknowledged finding disappears). One low-stock rule in notices_v1 and staff_home_v1: is_active and reorder_below is not null and qty_on_hand <= reorder_below (staff_home_v1 used <, so an item exactly at its level now shows in the home warnings). notices_v1 and staff_home_v1 are copies of the live s82 bodies with exactly those two edits. Fix round: ops_notice_close_v1 closes only hand-added notices (source manual/staff, or no source on a non-brownout) and returns {ok:false,error:not_closable} for feed notices; its audit row is labelled soft_delete via admin_audit_context_v1. RLS policies guests_owner_admin_all and airbnb_reservations_owner_admin_all now use current_staff_active(owner, admin) instead of the JWT role claim (a disabled or session-revoked admin loses access at once); public.guests loses TRUNCATE, REFERENCES and TRIGGER for anon and authenticated and every privilege for anon.
backup.notes: Additive: one nullable column, one trigger, three new functions, two replaced function bodies (guarded on the live md5). Old apps keep working: they never read the column, and notices_v1/staff_home_v1 keep their payload shape. Deploy order: SQL first, then the Staff app that calls the three new RPCs.
